name: UNAUTHORIZED
summary: The caller does not hold a role this call allows

name: ROLE_CONFLICT
summary: An address would hold two roles that must stay apart

name: ROLE_SET_FULL
summary: A role set would exceed its bound

name: MANDATE_REVOKED
summary: The mandate is revoked

name: MANDATE_EXPIRED
summary: The mandate is expired

name: MANDATE_PAUSED
summary: The mandate is paused

name: ALREADY_PAUSED
summary: Pause while paused

name: NOT_PAUSED
summary: Resume while not paused

name: MANDATE_ACTIVE
summary: Sweep while the mandate is active

name: PRINCIPAL_CHANGE_PENDING
summary: A third-party sweep while a principal change is proposed

name: SWEEP_GRACE_PERIOD
summary: A third-party sweep within the grace after expiry

name: AMOUNT_INVALID
summary: An amount outside its domain

name: LEGS_INVALID
summary: Leg count, leg amount, zero address, tag form or duplicate destination

name: LEGS_SUM_MISMATCH
summary: Legs do not sum to the total

name: BATCH_INVALID
summary: Batch length or transfer budget out of bounds

name: CONFIG_INVALID
summary: A configuration value or change is not allowed, including an attester key that is not 32 bytes or is 32 zero bytes

name: REQUEST_DEADLINE_PASSED
summary: The request arrived at or after its deadline

name: BUDGET_EXCEEDED
summary: The charge exceeds the remaining budget

name: PAYMENT_CAP_EXCEEDED
summary: The charge exceeds the per-payment cap

name: DAILY_CAP_EXCEEDED
summary: The total exceeds the recipient's daily headroom

name: INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS
summary: The charge exceeds the free balance or the balance

name: BUDGET_BELOW_RESERVED
summary: A new budget below what is already reserved or spent

name: NOTHING_TO_SWEEP
summary: Sweep with a zero balance

name: FEE_EXCEEDS_CAP
summary: The fee exceeds the fee cap for the total

name: RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED
summary: A leg destination is not on the allowlist for the recipient

name: ATTESTATION_INVALID
summary: An attestation where none is allowed, the wrong number of attestations, a window longer than MAX_ATTESTATION_VALIDITY, or a signature that is not 64 bytes. A wrongly signed attestation is a host trap on Stellar, not this code (MANDATE-RECIPIENT-012)

name: ATTESTATION_EXPIRED
summary: An attestation at or after its valid_until

name: POLICY_CHANGED
summary: The mandate's policy epoch differs from the epoch the attestation was issued under: at request (MANDATE-RECIPIENT-019) or at execute (MANDATE-RECIPIENT-015)

name: WRONG_RECIPIENT_MODE
summary: A call that the recipient mode does not use

name: PAYOUT_ID_EXISTS
summary: The payout ID was already used

name: PAYOUT_NOT_FOUND
summary: No payout with that ID

name: PAYOUT_WRONG_STATUS
summary: The payout is not in a status this call accepts

name: PAYOUT_LAPSED
summary: The payout is at or after its own expiry

name: ALREADY_APPROVED
summary: A repeated approval or recovery vote

name: AGENT_REMOVED
summary: The agent that requested the payout is no longer an agent

name: ASSET_NOT_SUPPORTED
summary: The factory does not support the asset

name: WRONG_ASSET
summary: Token recovery of the settlement asset

name: TRANSFER_FAILED
summary: A token transfer out of the mandate failed

name: INTERNAL_INVARIANT
summary: An arithmetic failure the rules make unreachable
